findings.title: Edits proceed without post-change validation, leaving regressions undetected
findings.reason: Session evidence observed 277 edit events across 38 sessions but zero validation commands (test, lint, typecheck, or build). The project declares npm test, npm run lint, and npm run typecheck in package.json, and 15 test files exist under server/tests/, but no project instruction routes the agent to run these checks after edits. The change-validation dimension is capped at Missing because no relevant-check was observed. Confidence: High for the edit/validation gap; Medium for the causal link to missing instructions.
expectedOutput: Update the existing Document owner identified by the reviewed evidence and retain a focused validation result.

findings.title: Highest-churn frontend files have no test coverage, so behavior changes cannot be verified
findings.reason: The project profile shows 82 TSX source files with 0 test files. The hottest file, src/pages/wf-designer.tsx, has 27 commits and 3090 lines of churn in a 4-day history, with no corresponding test. The second hottest frontend file, src/pages/wf-agent-editor.tsx, has 14 commits and 1258 lines of churn, also with no test. The project declares npm test (pytest) which covers only server/tests/. The frontend test infrastructure has only 2 TypeScript test files (src/lib/list-filters.test.ts and src/pages/wf-agents-list.test.ts). Without focused checks, behavior changes in the most actively developed UI files cannot be mechanically verified. Confidence: High for the coverage gap; Medium for the causal link to missing test infrastructure guidance.
expectedOutput: Update the existing Test owner identified by the reviewed evidence and retain a focused validation result.

findings.title: No project instructions guide agent context, validation, or scope boundaries
findings.reason: The project has 151 source files across src/, server/, and scripts/ but no AGENTS.md or equivalent instruction file. The agent-lint envelope confirms 0 tracked AGENTS.md files. Without instructions, the agent lacks routing to canonical owners (e.g., src/domain/types.ts for contracts, server/app/models.py for ORM, docs/sdd/ for design specs), validation commands after edits, and scope boundaries for high-risk paths. This amplifies findings 1 and 2: the validation gap and test gap persist partly because no instruction routes the agent to them. Confidence: High for the absence; Medium for the causal contribution to validation drift.
